blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Selecting an effective cover photo is a critical yet understudied problem in visual merchandising for e-commerce marketplaces. On Airbnb, hosts upload many photos depicting different rooms, amenities, and points of interest, but must manually choose a single static cover photo that is reused across heterogeneous product surfaces. This creates substantial challenges: over 90\% of listing photos have no engagement labels, leading to a severe cold-start regime; guest preferences vary across surfaces and search intents, and visually captivating photos may be semantically misaligned with the underlying listing. At Airbnb scale, this corresponds to hundreds of millions of photos and hundreds of thousands of new uploads per day.
  We propose \emph{OptiCover}, a scalable framework for cold-start visual optimization under semantic constraints and multi-surface engagement signals. The framework combines (i) a photo candidate generator that identifies candidate photos through various proxies, (ii) lightweight vision heads applied to frozen CLIP embeddings for large-scale semantic scoring, (iii) a cross-modal grounding validator based on a vision-language model (VLM) that enforces semantic representativeness, and (iv) an Exploration Logging Module (ELM) that orchestrates the collection of randomized engagement data across heterogeneous product surfaces and contextual search intents.
  We evaluate OptiCover through extensive offline studies and multiple online experiments across HomePage, and Search surfaces. OptiCover is now deployed in production and performs tens of millions of photo swaps daily. Online results show a 1.5\% engagement lift on the HomePage and a 0.35\% increase in bookers on Search, generating millions of dollars in incremental revenue. Our findings suggest that action-space shaping and semantic constraints are primary drivers of performance.
blocks.zh:
选择有效的封面照片是电子商务市场视觉交易中一个关键但未得到充分研究的问题。 在Airbnb上,主机上传了许多描绘不同房间、便利设施以及兴趣点的照片,但必须手动选择一张不同产品表面重复使用的静态封面照片。 这带来了巨大的挑战:90多张上市照片没有订婚标签,导致严酷的冷落起步制度;不同表面和搜索意图的来宾偏好不一;视觉上映照片可能与基本上市错配. 在Airbnb尺度上,这相当于每天有上亿相片和上下数十万相片.
我们提议\emph{OptiCover},一个在语义限制和多地表接触信号下冷启动视觉优化的可扩展框架。 该框架结合了以下内容:(一) 照片候选生成器,通过各种代位识别候选相片;(二) 轻量级视觉头用于为大规模语义评分而嵌入被冻结的CLIP; (三) 基于语义代表性的视觉语言模型(VLM)的跨模式地基验证器; (四) 用于协调收集不同产品表面和背景搜索意图的随机接触数据的勘探记录模块。
我们通过广泛的离线研究和在HomePage和Search表面的多重在线实验来评价OptiCover。 OptiCover现已投入生产,每天进行数千万次相机交换。 网上结果显示,HomePage上有1.5QQ参与电梯,而Search上的订户人数则增加了0.35QQ,从而产生了数百万美元的增收. 我们的调查结果表明,行动空间的形成和语义上的制约是表现的主要动力。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: Cover photos play a central role in online marketplaces, often serving as the first visual signal users encounter. Most platforms delegate the choice of this photo to sellers, despite the fact that items typically have many images that highlight different attributes, spaces, and amenities. On Airbnb, for example, hosts upload dozens of photos but must manually select a single static cover photo that is shown across all user experiences. This choice is inherently subjective and insensitive to user intent: the photo that performs well on the HomePage may not be the best choice for guests searching for a specific amenity (e.g., pools) or visiting during different seasons.
blocks.zh: 封面相片在网络市场中起中心作用,经常成为视觉信号用户第一次遇到. 大部分平台将这张照片的选择权委托给销售商,尽管物品通常有许多突出不同属性、空间和设施的图像。 例如,在Airbnb上,主机上传了数十张照片,但必须手动选择一张在所有用户体验中显示的静态封面照片. 这种选择在本质上是主观的,对用户的用意不敏感:HomePage上表现良好的相片可能不是寻找特定舒适感(如池子)的来宾或不同季节来客的最佳选择.

blocks.en: Selecting an “optimal” cover photo is therefore a deeply context-dependent problem. Yet, expecting hosts to choose effective photos for all contexts is infeasible. As a result, fixed cover photos frequently fail to reflect what users are searching for, leaving significant engagement and booking value unrealized.
blocks.zh: 因此,选择“最佳”封面照片是一个非常依赖背景的问题。 然而,要求主机为所有背景选择有效相片是不可行的。 因此,固定封面照片往往无法反映用户正在寻找什么,因此没有实现重大的接触和预订价值。

blocks.en: Optimizing cover photos dynamically and at scale introduces several technical challenges. First, marketplaces face a significant cold-start regime: over 90% of Airbnb listing photos have never been displayed as a cover photo and thus lack direct engagement labels. Second, guest preferences vary substantially across heterogeneous product surfaces (HomePage, Search results), each with distinct visibility, traffic patterns, and user intent. Third, visual optimization must remain semantically faithful to the underlying listing; while some photos are highly engaging, they may depict nearby points of interest or lifestyle scenes that misrepresent the space and risk degrading user on-trip experience. In such environments, the default action space is severely constrained to the current listing covers. Finally, the system must adapt to non-stationary engagement patterns driven by seasonality and demand shifts.
blocks.zh: 动态和大规模地优化封面照片带来了若干技术挑战。 首先,市场面临一个显著的冷启动制度:超过90%的Airbnb列出的照片从未作为封面照片被显示,因此缺乏直接接触标签。 第二,不同产品表面(HomePage、搜索结果)的宾客偏好差别很大,每种产品都有明显的能见度、流量模式和用户意图。 第三,视觉优化必须始终忠实于基本列表;虽然一些相片非常吸引人,但是它们可能描绘附近的一些兴趣点或生活方式场景,这些场景歪曲了空间,并有可能使用户在旅行中遭受侮辱。 在这种环境中,默认的行动空间严重受限于目前的上市封面. 最后,该系统必须适应季节性和需求变化所驱动的非固定参与模式。

blocks.en: Addressing these challenges requires a framework that can (i) construct a high-quality, both representative and engaging, action space despite severe label sparsity, (ii) enforce semantic constraints to prevent misrepresentation, and (iii) leverage multi-surface engagement signals to generalize across contexts. In this work, we present OptiCover , a scalable framework for cold-start visual optimization under semantic constraints and multi-surface engagement signals. OptiCover combines lightweight vision heads trained on frozen CLIP embeddings for large-scale candidate generation, a cross-modal grounding module that validates semantic representativeness, and an Exploration Logging Module that explores photos across heterogeneous surfaces and search intents.
blocks.zh: 应对这些挑战需要一个框架,能够(一) 尽管存在严重的标签螺旋性,但构建一个具有代表性和参与性的高质量行动空间,(二) 实施语义限制,防止错报,以及(三) 利用多地表接触信号,在各种背景中加以概括。 在这项工作中,我们介绍了OptiCover,这是在语义限制和多地表接触信号下冷启动视觉优化的可扩展框架。 OptiCover结合了为大规模候选者一代进行冷冻CLIP嵌入培训的轻量级视觉头,验证语义代表性的跨模式地平面模块,以及探索不同表面相片和搜索意图的探索日志模块.

blocks.en: We evaluate OptiCover through extensive offline analyses and multiple online experiments across HomePage and Search surfaces. Beyond improving business metrics, our results highlight broader methodological insights: action-space shaping is a primary driver of performance in a semantically constrained environment, semantic grounding is essential for safe visual optimization, and cross-surface transfer enabling new surface bootstrapping. Together, these findings illustrate a practical and generalizable approach for large-scale visual merchandising in modern marketplaces.
blocks.zh: 我们通过广泛的离线分析和在HomePage和Search表面的多起在线实验来评价OptiCover. 除了改进业务衡量标准外,我们的成果还突出了更广泛的方法见解:行动空间的塑造是造成在受约束环境中业绩的主要动力,语义地平地对安全视觉优化至关重要,跨地平面的转移能够使新的地平面被束缚。 这些调查结果共同说明了现代市场大规模视觉交易的实用而通俗的方法。

blocks.en: 1.1. Background
blocks.zh: 1.1. 背景情况

blocks.en: In this section, we outline important prerequisites for understanding the unique challenges associated with our problem at hand, which motivated our approach and architecture choices.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们概述了了解与我们手头的问题有关的独特挑战的重要先决条件,这促使我们作出办法和结构选择。

blocks.en: 1.1.1. Data Collection and Seed Training Set
blocks.zh: 1.1.1. 数据收集和种子培训集

blocks.en: Modeling photo-driven engagement has historically been challenging due to the lack of large-scale, unbiased training data. In practice, two main approaches have been used, both with significant limitations.
blocks.zh: 由于缺乏大规模、无偏见的培训数据,模拟以相片为动力的参与历来具有挑战性。 在实践中,采用了两种主要方法,两种方法都有很大的局限性。

blocks.en: The first approach relies on supervised learning—typically logistic regression—to predict engagement signals such as click-through rate (CTR), using observable confounders as covariates. However, this strategy is highly sensitive to unobserved confounding and selection bias, leading to unstable estimates and limited generalization when applied to ranking or optimization tasks.
blocks.zh: 第一种方法依靠有监督的学习——典型的后勤回归——来预测接触信号,如点击率(CTR),使用可观察到的混杂物作为同变物。 然而,这一策略对无法观察的混淆和选择偏好非常敏感,导致估算不稳定,在应用到排名或优化任务时,概括性有限.

blocks.en: The second approach exploits natural experiments, for example, when hosts manually change the cover photo of a listing. Although appealing in principle, this method suffers from several practical issues in practice. Photo changes are often accompanied by simultaneous updates to other listing attributes (e.g., pricing, availability, or description), introducing co-action bias. In addition, engagement signals are strongly affected by temporal factors such as seasonality and demand fluctuations, further complicating causal attribution.
blocks.zh: 第二种方法利用自然实验,例如当主机手动改变列表的封面相片时. 这种方法虽然原则上是有吸引力的,但实际上却存在若干实际问题。 相片变化往往伴随着其他上市属性的同步更新(如定价,可用性,或描述等),引入了共动偏差. 此外,接触信号受到季节性和需求波动等时间因素的严重影响,使因果关系更加复杂。

blocks.en: 1.1.2. Cold Start and Shifting Engagement Patterns
blocks.zh: 1.1.2. 冷启动和转移参与模式

blocks.en: Engagement-based models also suffer from severe cold-start issues and non-stationary engagement patterns. At scale, this problem is particularly acute: every day, hosts upload hundreds of thousands of new photos to their listings. The vast majority of these images have never been used as a cover photo; in practice, we observe over 90% of listing photos lack any direct engagement observations, making supervised learning infeasible.
blocks.zh: 以接触为基础的模式还存在严重的冷启动问题和非固定的参与模式。 在规模上,这个问题特别尖锐:每天,主机上传上数十万张新相片到他们的上市. 这些照片中绝大多数从未被用作封面照片;实际上,我们观察到超过90%的上市照片缺乏任何直接的接触观察,这使得监督学习不可行。

blocks.en: In addition, engagement signals on Airbnb are highly seasonal and context-dependent. The relevance of a photo can change substantially over time as guest travel patterns shift with seasonality. For example, mountain destinations such as Lake Tahoe experience significantly different engagement dynamics across seasons, where a winter-focused photo may underperform during summer travel periods, and vice versa. As a result, historical engagement labels can quickly become stale and misaligned with current user preferences.
blocks.zh: 此外,Airbnb上的接战信号高度季节性并取决于具体情况. 随着旅客旅行模式随着季节性变化,照片的相关性会随着时间而发生重大变化。 例如,塔霍湖等山区目的地各季节的接触动态大相径庭,其中以冬季为重点的照片在夏季出行期间可能表现不佳,反之亦然。 因此,历史的接触标签会很快地变得僵化并被当前的用户偏好所错配.

blocks.en: 1.1.3. Representativeness

Listing photos convey more than the physical attributes of the property itself. Hosts frequently include images of the surrounding neighborhood, nearby amenities, and local points of interest (POIs) as part of their visual storytelling. While such images can be informative, they introduce an additional constraint when optimizing for engagement: the selected cover photo must remain representative of the actual listing.
blocks.zh: 列出相片传达的不仅仅是财产本身的物理属性. 主办方经常包括周边街区的影像,附近的福利设施,以及当地关注点(PoIs),作为其视觉故事讲述的一部分. 虽然这些图像可以提供信息,但在优化参与时又增加了一个制约因素:所选封面照片必须仍然能代表实际列名。

blocks.en: Optimizing solely for engagement without enforcing representativeness can result in misleading visual merchandising, where highly engaging but off-premise or contextually ambiguous images are promoted. This, in turn, may negatively impact guest expectations and downstream trip quality, even if short-term metrics such as click-through rates improve.
blocks.zh: 仅优化接触而不强制要求具有代表性可导致误导性的视觉交易,在这种交易中宣传高度接触但不真实或背景模糊的图像。 这反过来可能对客人的期望和下游旅行质量产生不利影响,即使点击率等短期衡量标准有所改善。

blocks.en: 1.2. Our Contribution
blocks.zh: 1.2. 我们的贡献

blocks.en: We present OptiCover , a scalable framework for cold-start visual optimization under semantic and contextual constraints in a large travel marketplace. To our knowledge, this is one of the first end-to-end systems that optimizes listing cover photos across heterogeneous product surfaces while addressing the combined challenges of sparse supervision, representativeness, and shifting user intent. Our key contributions are:
blocks.zh: OptiCover是大型旅行市场在语义和背景限制下冷启动视觉优化的可扩展框架。 据我们所知,这是第一个端到端的系统之一,它优化了不同产品表面的封面照片,同时应对监督不足、代表性和用户意图变化等共同挑战。 我们的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: • A scalable framework for cold-start visual optimization. We design an end-to-end system that can rank and select cover photos despite the fact that most listing images lack direct engagement labels, enabling robust performance under significant cold-start conditions. • A context-aware ranking approach that adapts to user intent and product surface. We introduce a surface- and context-sensitive ranking pipeline that conditions photo eligibility and engagement scoring on search filters, page theme, and surface-level objectives. • A lightweight, multi-task vision-head architecture for large-scale semantic scoring. We develop a modular set of vision heads on top of frozen CLIP embeddings to extract engagement predictions, quality signals, and semantic attributes at billion-scale with low latency. • A cross-modal grounding module enforcing semantic representativeness. We incorporate a VLM-based grounding validator that filters out non-representative or potentially misleading photos, ensuring optimization does not degrade user trust or trip quality. • A practical methodology for deploying visual optimization across heterogeneous product surfaces. We demonstrate that action-space expansion, semantic constraints, surface transfer and calibrated offline predictions are sufficient for safe and high-impact deployment across HomePage, and Search surfaces, yielding significant engagement and booking gains in production.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 冷启动视觉优化可扩展框架. 我们设计了一个端到端的系统,可以对封面相片进行分级和选择,尽管大多数上市的相片缺乏直接的接触标签,使得在显著的冷起动条件下能够强劲的性能. • 适应用户意图和产品表面的上下文意识排名办法。 我们引入了一个对地表和上下文敏感的排行线,以照片资格和接触评分为搜索过滤器、页面主题和地表目标的条件。 二. 支助 一个轻量级,多任务愿景-头像架构,用于大规模语义评分. 我们在冷冻的CLIP嵌入物上,开发出一套模块化的视觉头像,以提取接触预测,质量信号,和语义属性,在10亿个尺度上低潜. 二. 支助 一个执行语义代表性的跨模式地基模块. 我们加入了一个基于VLM的地面验证器,过滤出不具代表性或可能误导性的照片,确保优化不会降低用户的信任或出行质量。 二. 支助 在各种产品表面进行视觉优化的实用方法。 我们证明,扩大行动空间、语义限制、地表转移和校准离线预测,足以在HomePage和Search表面进行安全和高影响部署,从而在生产中产生重大参与和预定收益。

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: Our work intersects three areas: visual merchandising in marketplaces, vision-based engagement modeling, and large-scale online experimentation.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作跨越三个领域:市场中的视觉交易、基于视觉的接触模式和大规模在线实验。

blocks.en: 2.1. Creative Selection and Visual Merchandising
blocks.zh: 2.1. 创造性选择和视觉商业化

blocks.en: Prior systems for optimizing representative images—such as Netflix artwork personalization ( amat18 ) , Tripadvisor cover photo ranking ( Myeongjin25 ) , and Hotels.com hero-image testing ( Fedor20 ) —demonstrate that visual choices strongly affect engagement. However, these approaches typically operate over small, well-defined, candidate sets with dense supervision and do not address representativeness constraints or significant cold start. Related work on e-commerce image ranking ( gomez22 ) and creative generation ( czapp24 ) emphasizes personalization and aesthetic quality but is less applicable to travel, where photos must remain faithful to the underlying property. In contrast, OptiCover tackles a substantially larger and noisier action space while enforcing semantic fidelity across heterogeneous product surfaces.
blocks.zh: 优化代表性图像的先行系统——如Netflix艺术品个性化(amat18),Tripadvisor覆盖相片排名(Myongjin25)和Hotels.com英雄形象测试(Fedor20)——表明视觉选择严重影响了接触。 然而,这些办法通常在有严格监督的小型、定义明确的候选套件上运作,并不涉及代表性限制或重大冷门。 关于电子商务形象排名(gomez22)和创造性生成(czapp24)的相关工作强调个性化和美学质量,但不太适用于旅行,因为旅行中的照片必须忠于基本财产。 相比之下,OptiCover处理一个大得多的和噪声的动作空间,同时在不同的产品表面执行语义忠诚。

blocks.en: 2.2. Vision-Based Engagement Modeling
blocks.zh: 2.2. 基于愿景的参与模式

blocks.en: Large-scale vision–language models such as CLIP ( radford21 ) and SigLIP ( tschannen25 ) enable effective specialization learning for multimodal tasks. Lightweight heads trained on frozen embeddings provide efficient deployment across many classification tasks, and product quantization techniques ( Ge13 ) support large-scale storage and retrieval ( guy25 ) . OptiCover builds on these ideas by combining shared frozen embeddings with multi-task vision heads to extract engagement, quality, and semantic signals at scale, and by integrating cross-modal grounding to ensure representativeness.
blocks.zh: CLIP(radford21)和SigLIP(tschannn25)等大规模视觉-语言模型,为多式联运任务提供了有效的专业化学习。 接受过冷冻嵌入技术培训的轻量级头可有效部署许多分类任务,产品量化技术(Ge13)支持大规模存储和取回(gem25). OptiCover以这些想法为基础,将共享的冷冻嵌入与多任务愿景头相结合,以大规模提取接触、质量和语义信号,并整合跨模式地基以确保代表性。

blocks.en: 2.3. Large-Scale Online Experimentation and Policy Serving
blocks.zh: 2.3. 大型在线实验和政策服务

blocks.en: Hybrid offline–online systems that warm-start online policies with model predictions ( wang21 ) are effective when candidate sets are compact and rewards are stable. Bandit approaches such as Thompson Sampling have been applied to creative selection ( amat18 ; Fedor20 ) , but they assume dense feedback and low-variance reward distributions. In large travel marketplaces, action spaces are large but unvetted, supervision is sparse, and engagement is non-stationary across surfaces and seasons. OptiCover therefore emphasizes offline priors, action-space shaping, and semantic constraints as the primary optimization drivers, using online experimentation chiefly for randomized data collection and policy validation.

blocks.en: 4.1. Objective

OptiCover aims to discover the most engaging photo for a given search context (or absence of it, in case of the HomePage). Starting from a list of photo cover candidates that passed the quality and representativeness bar, for each listing our goal was to test them on real guest traffic and use the actual guest engagement signals to pinpoint the best one for a given search context. This required building several components of our system that are outlined below.

blocks.en: All vision heads are shallow MLPs applied to a frozen ViT CLIP backbone, consisting of a linear layer, a nonlinearity, and a task-specific output layer. Specifically, SigLIP-2 ( tschannen25 ) was selected for the frozen vision backbone. A common frozen ViT backbone was used instead of a fully finetuned ViT for each classification task due to performance constraints of nearly 1 billion listing photos. Due to its wide applicability, a single embedding from the shared ViT can serve all tasks. Furthermore, SigLIP-2 already produces a very strong image representation and Airbnb images are generally within the domain of the large-scale training data used in SigLIP-2. An additional performance optimization was needed because SigLIP-2 produces embeddings of dimension 1152, which can incur substantial latency and storage costs for Airbnb given the large number of images on the platform. All embeddings are quantized to 288 int8 codes with recipe O ​ P ​ Q ​ 288 ​ _ ​ 1152 , P ​ Q ​ 288 ​ x ​ 8 OPQ288\_1152,PQ288x8 following the procedure described in ( guy25 ) to reduce storage size, improve iteration speed. During training and inference, we decode the quantized embeddings on the fly back to the full 1152-dimensional vectors by integrating the decoder into the PyTorch forward pass.
blocks.zh: 所有视觉头都是被应用到被冻结的ViT CLIP主干线上浅的MLP,由线性地层,非线性地层,以及任务特定的输出地层组成. 具体而言,SigLIP-2(tschannn25)被选入了被冷冻的视觉主干. 由于近10亿张上市相片的性能限制,每个分类任务使用通用被冻结的ViT主干线,而不是完全微调的ViT. 由于其广泛的适用性,从共享的ViT中一个单一嵌入可以服务于所有任务. 此外,SigLIP-2已经产生了非常强烈的图像表现,Airbnb图像一般属于SigLIP-2中使用的大规模培训数据的范围. 需要进行额外的性能优化,因为SigLIP-2生产出1152尺寸的嵌入,由于平台上有大量的图像,Airbnb可能会产生很大的耐久性和存储成本. 所有嵌入被量化为288英寸8代码,配有配方O P Q 288_1152,P Q 288×8 OPQ288×1152,PQ288×8按照(gem25)所描述的程序来降低存储大小,提高迭代速度. 在训练和推论期间,我们通过将解码器整合到PyTorch前行通道中,将分解后嵌入到苍蝇上到全1152维向量上.

blocks.en: All vision heads are trained using the AdamW optimizer ( l ​ r = 0.001 lr=0.001 over 20 epochs) and a cross entropy loss. We use an early stopping criterion using a validation set. Then, all evaluations were performed on a test set. All training datasets were shuffled each epoch.

blocks.en: The CTR prediction vision head adopts a Siamese architecture trained with a pairwise learning-to-rank objective (Algorithm 1 ). Pairs of image embeddings are processed by a shared network and optimized to predict which image exhibits higher CTR. Importantly, this pairwise loss yields scores calibrated as the probability that an image wins, rather than as absolute CTR estimates.
blocks.zh: CTR预测视觉头采用训练有素的暹罗式建筑,具有双向学习至分级目标(Agorithm 1 . 图像嵌入的对等由共享网络处理并优化,以预测哪些图像显示更高的CTR. 重要的是,这种双向损失的得分被校准为图像胜出概率,而不是绝对的CTR估计.

blocks.en: 4.3.3. CTR Calibration
blocks.zh: 4.3.3. CTR校正

blocks.en: Calibrated estimates of CTR for images is a desirable property of the CTR model.
blocks.zh: 校准的图像CTR估计是CTR模型的理想属性.

blocks.en: Instead of calibrating the CTR logits during pairwise training which may hurt ranking performance, we trained a post-hoc calibration model. As the CTR model’s primary aim remains to rank images, care must be taken to ensure that post-hoc calibration methods do not substantially alter the ordering. We explored isotonic and spline calibration methods as both methods guarantee monotonic behavior. In addition, spline calibration offers smooth transition thanks to its piecewise polynomial function. This property is particularly important in our setting, where the predicted CTR distribution is compressed and many images have similar predicted CTR values. Under these conditions, isotonic calibration tends to collapse neighboring scores into flat segments, eliminating fine-grained distinctions between images and reducing effective score resolution. In practice, while our experiments showed that isotonic and spline calibration achieved nearly identical calibration error, we selected spline calibration.
blocks.zh: 而不是在对等训练中校正CTR对数 这会损害排名的性能, 我们训练了一个后热校正模型。 由于CTR模型的首要目的仍然是对图像进行排序,因此必须注意确保后热校正方法不会实质性地改变订单. 我们探索了同位素和同位素校正方法,因为这两种方法都保证了单调行为。 此外,由於其片式多诺米函数,分型校正提供平稳过渡. 这个属性在我们设定中特别重要,其中预测的CTR分布被压缩,许多图像也有类似的预测CTR值. 在这些条件下,同位素校正往往会使相邻的分数崩溃为平分分,去除图像之间的细微分分辨,并降低有效分分辨度. 在实践中,虽然我们的实验表明同位素和相线校正实现了几乎相同的校正误差,但我们选择了相线校正.

blocks.en: 4.5. Listing Grounding Validator
blocks.zh: 4.5. 列出地基验证仪

blocks.en: The Listing Grounding Validator is a cross-modal validation module designed to assess whether a candidate photo is semantically representative of the underlying listing. Given the importance of visual misrepresentation in trip quality, the validator operates as a conservative filtering stage that prioritizes recall over precision to maintain trip quality.
blocks.zh: 列表地平面验证器是一个跨模式验证模块,旨在评估候选相片是否对基本列表具有整体代表性. 鉴于目视错报在出行质量中的重要性,校验器作为保守的过滤阶段运作,将召回比精度优先,以保持出行质量.

blocks.en: For each candidate photo, the validator compares visual content against multiple sources of listing context, including host-provided captions and the full listing description (Table 3 ). The task is formulated as a binary grounding decision: whether the photo is consistent with the listing’s described space, amenities, and nearby points of interest, or whether it depicts content that is potentially misleading (e.g., unrelated landmarks, nearby attractions, or off-premise location).
blocks.zh: 对于每张候选相片,验证员将视觉内容与多个列名来源的上下文进行比较,包括主机提供的字幕和完整的列名说明(表3.). 任务被设定为二进制定点决定:照片是否与被列名者描述的空间、福利设施以及附近利益点一致,或是否描绘了可能具有误导性的内容(例如无关的地标、附近景点或不真实的地点)。

blocks.en: We implement the validator using a large multimodal language model (VLM) prompted to perform structured cross-modal classification over the image and textual inputs. The model produces a grounding verdict along with interpretable rationales, which are subsequently consumed as hard filters by the downstream ranking engine 4.6 .

blocks.en: To evaluate, a team of experts annotated 1k photo–listing pairs. Based on the performance benchmark, we selected OpenAI’s 4o-mini model for its strong recall characteristics, achieving a macro F1 score of 0.82 within this benchmark. This recall-oriented operating point aligns with our product requirement to minimize unrepresentative candidates, ensuring that potentially misleading photos are filtered before being surfaced to guests.
blocks.zh: 为了评估,一个专家小组附加了1k相片-名单对子的说明。 基于性能基准,我们选择了OpenAI的4o-mini模型,以其强大的召回特性,在这个基准内达到0.82的宏F1分. 这个面向召回的操作点符合我们的产品要求,即尽量减少不具代表性的候选者,确保潜在误导性的照片被过滤后再被露出给来宾.

blocks.en: The Candidate Ranking Engine converts the candidate pool (Section 4.4 ) into a context-aware ranking for online selection. Given a listing l l and context ( s , c ) (s,c) (e.g., surface, query, or filters), the engine applies:

blocks.en: 4.7. Exploration Logging Module (ELM)
blocks.zh: 4.7. 勘探伐木模块

blocks.en: OptiCover operates in a significant cold-start regime where most candidate photos have no prior engagement labels. The primary role of the online component is therefore twofold: (i) collect unbiased engagement feedback over a dynamically constructed candidate set, and (ii) deploy a stable selection policy that adapts to heterogeneous product surfaces and context.
blocks.zh: OptiCover在相当重要的冷启动制度下运作,大多数候选相片没有事先的订婚标签. 因此,在线部分的主要作用是双重的:(一) 收集对一组动态构建的候选人的无偏见的参与反馈,(二) 部署一个适应不同产品表面和背景的稳定甄选政策。

blocks.en: We evaluated a hybrid Thompson Sampling policy as an online baseline, but found that in our ultra-cold-start and large-action-space setting, the calibrated exploit policy grounded in offline engagement modeling initially performed substantially better. The Thompson Sampling policy gradually closed this gap as observations accumulated (Section 4.9.4 ), suggesting that its initial underperformance was driven by slow convergence under sparse and noisy rewards, further compounded by system feedback lag. This motivated our use of the calibrated offline model as the production exploit policy, particularly for newly introduced candidates with limited engagement history.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了混合汤普森采样政策作为在线基线,但发现在我们超冷启动和大型行动空间的设定中,基于离线接触模式的校准利用政策最初表现要好得多。 汤普森抽样政策随着观察结果的积累而逐渐缩小了这一差距(第4.9.4节),表明其最初的绩效不佳是由于在鲜有和吵闹的回报下缓慢趋同而导致的,而系统的反馈滞后又进一步加剧了这一点。 这促使我们使用校准的离线模型作为生产开发政策,特别是针对参与历史有限的新提出的候选人。

blocks.en: 4.7.1. Exploration and Logging
blocks.zh: 4.7.1. 勘探和伐木

blocks.en: For each listing and context, the Candidate Ranking Engine (Section 4.6 ) produces a daily set of k k eligible photo candidates, along with eligible context, which defines the action space. To collect unbiased training data, an online ϵ \epsilon -greedy exploration policy with ϵ = 0.1 \epsilon=0.1 : with probability ϵ \epsilon used to uniformly sample an eligible candidate; otherwise, we serve the current exploit choice. For each impression, we log the candidate set, the selected action, surface and context features, and downstream engagement events. This produces randomized, balanced, comparisons across candidate photos, which we later convert into photo pairs for the engagement head.

blocks.en: 4.7.2. Deployment Policy (Exploit)
blocks.zh: 4.7.2. 部署政策(剥削)

blocks.en: In exploitation, we select the eligible candidate with the highest calibrated predicted CTR (Section 4.3 ) for the context c c using the output of the photo ranking engine 4.6 , stored daily in a Key Value store. Since the CTR model is lightweight, retraining and deployments carry a low operational burden.
blocks.zh: 在开发过程中,我们利用照片排名引擎4.6的输出,为上下文c选择具有最高校正预想CTR(第4.3节)的合格候选人,每天存储在Key Value商店. 由于CTR模式是轻量级的,再培训和部署的操作负担较低.

blocks.en: For HomePage and Search, we evaluate an Exploit policy that selects candidates using predicted CTR. The CTR model is trained using pairwise engagement data collected by the ELM 4.7 over a 5-week exploration period. Due to data availability, the deployed model is trained exclusively on HomePage data rather than using the generalized multi-surface training procedure described in Algorithm 1 . This provides a natural test of cross-surface transfer.
blocks.zh: 对于HomePage和Search,我们评价一项利用预测的CTR来选择候选人的剥削政策. 利用ELM 4.7在5周的勘探期间收集的对等接触数据对CTR模型进行培训。 由于有数据可用,所部署的模型只接受HomePage数据培训,而不是使用算法中描述的通用多地表培训程序 1 (英语). 这为跨地转移提供了一个自然的测试.

blocks.en: On Search, we first evaluated a non-contextual variant that directly applies this transferred CTR model to select the highest-scoring eligible photo. Despite producing a statistically significant 0.32% CTR lift, this treatment produced no significant increase in Bookers (+0.075%, 95% CI: [ − 0.14 % , 0.29 % ] [-0.14\%,0.29\%] ). Analysis indicated that the additional engagement primarily redistributed bookings across listings rather than generating incremental bookings. This result highlights an important limitation of directly optimizing an intermediate engagement metric on a downstream marketplace surface: increased local engagement does not necessarily translate into incremental conversion.
blocks.zh: 在"搜索"(Search)上,我们首先评价了一个非文字变体,直接应用了这个被转移的CTR模型来选择评分最高的合格相片. 尽管生产了具有统计重要性的0.32%的CTR升降机,但这种处理并未导致布克公司大幅增加(+0.075%,95%CI:[−0.14%,0.29%][-0.14-%,0.29-%])。 分析表明,额外业务主要是跨清单重新分配预订,而不是产生递增预订。 这一结果凸显出在下游市场表面直接优化中间参与衡量标准的一个重要局限性:增加当地参与不一定转化为递增转换。

blocks.en: In parallel, we evaluated a contextual Search policy that constrains the candidate action space according to the guest’s search intent before applying the engagement model. Opticover is only applied to seven filters selected by the Product team: pools, hot tub, kitchen, waterfront, lakefront, ski-in/ski-out, and indoor fireplace. In contrast to the non-contextual policy, the contextual treatment produces a significant 0.35% increase in Bookers (95% CI: [ 0.01 % , 0.69 % ] [0.01\%,0.69\%] ), despite a non-significant +0.14% CTR effect. Together, these experiments demonstrate that action-space contextualization can be more important than maximizing the intermediate CTR objective itself when optimizing downstream marketplace outcomes.
blocks.zh: 与此同时,我们评价了一项背景搜索政策,在应用接触模式之前,根据客人的搜索意图限制候选行动空间。 Opticover只应用于产品团队所选择的7个过滤器:游泳池,热浴缸,厨房,水边,湖口,滑雪/滑雪,以及室内壁炉. 与非文字政策不同的是,尽管CTR效应不显著+0.14%,但上下文处理在布克语中产生了0.35%的大幅增长(95% CI:[0.01%,0.69%] [0.01\%,0.69\%]). 这些实验共同表明,在优化下游市场结果时,行动空间背景化比最大限度地实现中间CTR目标本身更为重要。

blocks.en: The Search experiments also demonstrate a practical form of cross-surface transfer: a CTR model trained entirely on HomePage engagement data can be used to bootstrap optimization on a new surface before sufficient surface-specific training data becomes available. Algorithm 1 generalizes this approach to surface-specific engagement models once such data is available.
blocks.zh: 搜索实验还展示了一种跨地平面传输的实际形式:在获得足够的地平面特定培训数据之前,完全通过HomePage参与数据培训的CTR模型可以用于在新地平面上进行拖带优化。 算法1在获得这些数据后,将这种方法概括到地表特定接战模型上.

blocks.en: Finally, we report Bookers because it is Airbnb’s primary metric for revenue attribution. The observed Search improvement corresponds to millions of dollars in incremental revenue.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们报告Bookers是因为它是Airbnb的收入归属的主要衡量标准。 所观察到的搜索改进相当于数百万美元增收。

blocks.en: 4.9. Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.9. 读取研究

blocks.en: To understand the role played by the different components of this complex workflow, we conduct ablation studies on the different components: • Ablation of Candidate Generation Engine focusing on how candidate generation, through its critical expansion of the action space affects performance • In-training Auxiliary calibration loss vs. post training calibration justifying the added complexity by superior calibration results • Ablation of the Listing Grounding Validation showing higher representativeness than unimodal approaches • Online Policy Comparison showing that a strong offline CTR exploit policy outperforms Thompson Sampling during cold start, while the decreasing regret gap suggests that Thompson Sampling improves as online observations accumulate
blocks.zh: 为了了解这一复杂工作流程的不同组成部分所起的作用,我们对不同组成部分进行了减员研究: ● 利用候选一代引擎,重点研究候选一代如何通过关键地扩大行动空间影响业绩; • 培训辅助校正损失与培训后校正,证明由于优异校正结果而增加的复杂性; • 核对清单地基验证,显示代表性高于单一模式方法; • 在线政策比较,显示强有力的线下CTR利用政策在冷酷启动期间超越汤普森抽样,而不断减少的遗憾差距表明,随着在线观察的积累,汤普森抽样工作有所改善

blocks.en: 4.9.2. In-training auxiliary calibration vs. post-hoc calibration
blocks.zh: 4.9.2. 训练辅助校准与后校准

blocks.en: We evaluated two approaches for CTR calibration.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了两种CTR校正方法.

blocks.en: First, following Wang et al. ( wang21 ) Eq. 11, we augmented the pairwise ranking loss with a pointwise MSE calibration term weighted by γ \gamma . Hyperparameter sweeps showed improved raw CTR calibration, with γ = 0.42 \gamma=0.42 providing the best tradeoff between calibration and ranking quality. However, calibration errors remained, particularly at the extremes (Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh: 首先,在Wang et al. (Wang21) Eq. 11之后,我们增加了双向排名损失,并用 QQ\gamma 加权的分点MSE 校正术语。 超参数扫描显示原始CTR校正有所改善,γ=0.42\gamma=0.42提供了校正和排名质量的最佳取舍. 然而,校正错误依然存在,特别是在极端(图4)。

blocks.en: Second, we applied a post-hoc monotonic calibrator (spline regression). Although this adds an offline calibration step, it consistently reduced miscalibration more than the auxiliary in-training loss alone, motivating our final approach.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们应用了后热单声道算法(spline regress). 虽然这增加了离线校正步骤,但始终比仅培训中辅助损失更能减少误判,促使我们采取最后办法。

blocks.en: 4.9.3. Ablation of the Listing Grounding Validator
blocks.zh: 4.9.3. 列入清单的地基验证仪的出现

blocks.en: We evaluated the impact of the Listing Grounding Validator on 1k randomly sampled candidates produced by the Candidate Engine. Candidates were annotated for representativeness using the rubric in Section • ‣ 4.5 .
blocks.zh: 我们评价了名单定位验证器对候选人引擎生产的1克随机抽样候选人的影响。 候选人在说明代表性时使用了第4.5节的标题。

blocks.en: We compare the full pipeline against a “no-grounding” variant relying only on engagement ranking, filtering, and a vision-only representativeness classifier. Removing the grounding validator reduced recall of non-representative photos from 98% to 89%, resulting in a 5.3 × \times increase in non-representative outputs while filtering 14% fewer candidates. Most failures were off-premise images (e.g., nearby POIs).
blocks.zh: 我们把整个管道与“不打地平线”的变体进行比较,这种变体只依靠参与排名、过滤和仅具有视觉代表性的分类。 取消理由验证器将非代表性照片的召回率从98%降低到89%,导致非代表性产出增加5.3×x\x,同时过滤了14%的候选人。 大多数失败都是不真实的图像(例如附近的POI).

blocks.en: These results show that grounding validation is critical for preventing misleading photo selection.
blocks.zh: 这些结果显示地基验证对于防止误导性照片选择至关重要.

blocks.en: 5. Future Work
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 未来工作

blocks.en: Moving forward, the work can be extended from contextualization to personalization by incorporating guest-level preferences, as different guest segments may resonate with different photo types (e.g., families preferring pool photos in summer), building on contextual bandit methods ( Li10 ) .
blocks.zh: 向前看,作品可以通过纳入来宾级偏好来从上下文化到个性化,因为不同的来宾片段可能会与不同的相片类型产生共鸣(例如,家庭更喜欢夏天的池子相片),以上下文的"强盗"方法(Li10)为基础.

blocks.en: Another important direction is addressing a current system limitation: the inability to change the order of listing cards. Studying the benefits of integrating photo merchandising into the listing-card ranking model—jointly ranking listings and photos—may further enhance business impact.
blocks.zh: 另一个重要方向是解决目前的系统限制:无法改变挂牌顺序。 研究将相片交易纳入上市卡排名模式——联合排序的上市和相片——的好处,可进一步提高业务影响。

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 国家 结论

blocks.en: We proposed OptiCover, an approach to optimize contextual optimal cover photos in the industrial context of Airbnb listings. We demonstrated the usefulness of the approach across product surfaces, and objective functions. The framework introduces new components: a Listing Ground Validator for candidate validation, and a vision head framework for scalable vision tasks. The framework provides a useful compass to companies exploring photo optimization to drive conversion and ultimately revenue gains.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了OptiCover,这是一种在Airbnb上市的工业背景下优化背景最佳封面照片的方法. 我们展示了这一方法在产品表面和客观功能方面的效用。 该框架引入了新的组成部分:供候选人验证的列名地面验证器,以及可扩展的远景任务的远景头框架。 该框架为公司探索照片优化以推动转换并最终获得收入提供了一个有用的指南。

blocks.en: Looking forward, OptiCover sets the foundations for future work as the personalization can be extended to more guest need-states and, in the end, to the individual guest themselves.
blocks.zh: 展望未来, OptiCover为未来工作打下基础,因为个性化可以扩展到更多的来宾需要状态,最终也可以扩展到个别来宾本人.
